exposure: Clinical features of neonatal listeriosis (e.g., presentation timing)
Empirical antibiotic treatment (type and timing) in neonates and mothers
cohort: Neonates diagnosed with listeriosis, identified through a United Kingdom neonatal infection surveillance network between 2004 and 2014.
finding: Despite its rarity and prompt antibiotic use, neonatal listeriosis has a high case-fatality rate (21-24%), highlighting a need for improved adherence to national guidelines for empiric antibiotic choice in puerperal sepsis and preventative strategies for high-risk pregnant populations.
followup_time: Up to the end of the neonatal period
